summary.goal: Provide WebSocket proxy and REST endpoints for frontend to interact with relay channels
summary.context: Frontend cannot connect directly to relay daemon (Unix socket). Backend provides /ws/relay WebSocket endpoint that proxies to relay daemon, plus REST endpoints for channel operations.

acceptance_criteria.description: WebSocket endpoint /ws/relay proxies messages to relay daemon
User authentication passed through to relay (user entity)
GET /api/channels returns available channels for user
GET /api/channels/:id/messages returns message history
GET /api/channels/:id/presence returns online agents
Auto-create #plan-{id} channel when plan created
PlannerLead agent auto-joins plan channels

steps.title: Create WebSocket proxy endpoint
steps.description: Add WebSocket upgrade handler at /ws/relay that bridges frontend WebSocket to relay daemon. Use express-ws or similar. Authenticate user from session/token. Create relay user entity for the connection.

acceptance_criteria.description: /ws/relay accepts WebSocket upgrade
Connection authenticated via session cookie or token
User registered with relay as entityType: 'user'
Relay messages forwarded bidirectionally

steps.title: Implement channel management
steps.description: Create src/relay/channels.ts for channel operations. Create #planner channel on startup. Create #plan-{id} channel when plan created. Auto-join PlannerLead to channels.

acceptance_criteria.description: #planner channel exists after server startup
#plan-{id} channel created when plan created
Channel removed when plan deleted (optional)
getChannelsForUser(userId) returns list of accessible channels
GET /api/channels returns [{ id, name, unread_count, last_message? }]
GET /api/channels/:id/messages returns [{ id, from, content, timestamp }] with pagination
GET /api/channels/:id/presence returns [{ id, name, entityType, status }]

steps.title: Implement PlannerLead auto-spawn
steps.description: On server startup, spawn PlannerLead agent if relay connected. Agent joins #planner and all existing plan channels. Uses existing relay-planning-agent infrastructure.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerLead agent spawned on startup (if relay available)
Agent joins #planner channel
Agent joins existing #plan-{id} channels
Agent joins new plan channels when created

steps.title: Add mock channel support
steps.description: When relay unavailable, provide mock channel responses. Single #demo channel with simulated AI responses.

acceptance_criteria.description: Channels endpoint returns #demo channel when relay unavailable
Messages to #demo get mock AI responses
Presence shows 'Demo AI' in mock mode
